title: Dimensionless resistively loaded Josephson pair: finite-observation voltage sweep
model: Identical overdamped RSJ junctions in series with individual shunts r and shared load R; alpha=r/R; no capacitance, inductance, noise or thermal evolution
initial_distribution: Independent uniform phases in [-pi,pi), same paired draws for all conditions; no stochastic forcing
sweep_rule: Up and down are separate monotone sweeps, both initialized from the recorded phase draws. Continue from the endpoint after settling plus W=200. Fresh resets to each recorded draw at every bias.
window_rule: Replay both-setting post-settling states at dt=0.025 for W=800; compare nested W and four disjoint 200-unit blocks. Longer windows do not alter sweep continuation endpoints.
numerical_amendment: After the initial direct-phase implementation failed fixed-step and independent-solver gates, production was repeated in exact mean/log-separation coordinates. Tolerances, currents, starts and experiment durations were unchanged. Raw output stride became 5 to reduce archive size; integration steps remained 0.05/0.025. Initial failures and source snapshot are retained in audit/. No gate was relaxed.
inference_scope: Bootstrap intervals describe variability over initial-phase draws only; nested windows and settings are paired, not independent samples. Finite-window sweep gaps do not establish asymptotic hysteresis or a history law beyond the full phase state.
